prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 行标题 · 年度目标拆解 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "目标" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 108px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "截止" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 4: header "关键结果" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 541px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"将年度目标与负责人、截止日期和可衡量的关键结果对应起来，便于跟踪落实。","reading":"读者先按目标定位一行，再横向查看负责人、截止日期和关键结果；也可纵向比较各目标的责任人和时间安排。","groups":["目标与关键结果共同说明要达成什么及如何衡量，应保持清晰的行对应关系。","负责人与截止日期都是简短的执行信息，适合并列扫描，并应尽量完整显示。"],"keep_intact":["负责人姓名","截止日期及其连字符","关键结果中的数字、百分比和英文缩写"],"may_wrap":["目标名称可按中文语义自然换行，但应保持每行目标容易辨认。","关键结果是较长的描述性文字，可自然换行；目标名称也可利用这些文字形成的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [100, 67, 65, 127] · table 360×485px · row heights [36, 153, 106, 129, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [85, 67, 65, 142] · table 360×415px · row heights [36, 129, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [129, 67, 65, 98] · table 360×624px · row heights [36, 199, 153, 153, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"负责人和截止日期完整显示，目标名称容易辨认，各行的横向对应关系清楚。","problems":"关键结果换行较多，首行和第三行偏高，文字集中在右侧窄栏，行内出现较大片空白。","cause":"目标列占100px，关键结果列仅127px，长描述因此需要多行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"负责人和日期保持完整；关键结果比r0A更易连续阅读，行高更紧凑，目标仍可辨认，整体比例较均衡。","problems":"前两个目标名称各换为两行，关键结果的长句仍有较多断行，部分行中左侧空白明显。","cause":"目标列为85px，只容纳较短的中文片段；关键结果列142px仍需容纳远长于列宽的描述。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"目标名称均可单行显示，负责人和日期也完整，左侧三列便于纵向扫描。","problems":"关键结果被切成许多短行，阅读节奏破碎，表格过高，左侧出现大片空白，行的整体性减弱。","cause":"目标列增至129px，使关键结果列缩至98px，长描述最多占八行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"result-forward","widths":[80,67,65,147],"change":"以r0B为基础，将目标列缩小5px并让给关键结果，检查目标仍清楚的同时能否减少长句断行。"},{"name":"balanced-goals","widths":[91,67,65,136],"change":"在r0A与r0B之间调整目标和关键结果的比例，比较目标名称的换行位置与关键结果的阅读节奏。"},{"name":"compact-metadata","widths":[85,61,65,148],"change":"保留r0B的目标宽度，将负责人列缩小6px并让给关键结果；检查负责人表头和姓名是否仍能完整显示。"}]}
